action.name: Execute CF-A and EXEC-A-bound V1 Phase 1
action.objective: Publish the synthetic CF-A pass disposition, then execute/checksum complete PAIR-A R0/R1/R3/R4 and inner A1-A6/G5 under the frozen contracts.
prerequisites: CF-A synthetic benchmark passed on runtime/resource feasibility
No empirical, OF4, or held-out access occurred during benchmark
allowed_scope: publish the CF-A benchmark disposition before empirical access
execute complete PAIR-A R0/R1/R3/R4 with CF-A monthly Q/R and daily states
materialize immutable/checksummed outputs and PRE-OUTER checkpoint
use deterministic partitioning, caching, safe parallelism, and checkpoint/restart
forbidden_scope: all empirical dataset access before CF-A disposition and role guard publication
any pair screening, approximation, or PAIR-A reduction
silent R4 clock, variance-sharing, estimator, or model change
action.commit_scope: Conditional contract, synthetic benchmark, feasibility disposition, implementation/inner artifacts, state/log, and PRE-OUTER or new blocker only.
action.completion_condition: Validated immutable 2015-2019 inner outputs including R4 and PRE-OUTER checkpoint, or a new blocker affecting overall validity.
mandatory_stop_conditions: Any empirical access before CF-A disposition is published
Any PAIR-A reduction or R4 semantic change beyond the frozen monthly Q/R clock
